verdict.rationale: Abacum's scenario-planning page says users can build base, bull and bear versions from the same base and see revenue, hiring and cash respond to assumption changes. Headcount planning in the same model supports a hiring-wave scenario. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly shows a side-by-side comparison view of scenarios, and all support is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: documented side-by-side scenario comparison/variance view, explicit slipped-quarter timing scenarios, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create scenarios (a hiring wave, a slipped quarter, a downside case) and compare them side by side

citations.quote: Build base, bull and bear off the same base version. Change an assumption and watch revenue, hiring and cash move together.
Connect actuals, assumptions, forecasts, and scenarios in one governed workspace
Plan, approve and forecast headcount in the same connected model as your budget
